target.name: Dyna Robotics
target.founder: Lindon Gao, York Yang, Jason Ma

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $120M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 4 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.1B - $2.0B.

data.narrative:
Dyna Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $120M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable across the robotics and manufacturing sector, including later-stage companies like Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B) and Generalist AI ($2.0B Series B), as well as earlier-stage reference points like Walden Robotics ($1.1B Seed).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $120M total raised as a proxy base and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $240M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector comparables at the same or adjacent stage yields a median valuation of $1.7B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $2.0B. The dispersion reflects the maturity and capital intensity variation within the peer set.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $204M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $970M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around whether Dyna Robotics will command early-stage multiples closer to the $240M level or track toward later-stage peer valuations approaching $1.7B-$2.0B. Key sensitivities include progress toward subsequent fundraising milestones, revenue traction relative to peer benchmarks, and technology differentiation within an increasingly competitive sector.
